chunks: From him, from Safwan, from Ibn Muskan, from Isma'il ibn 'Abd al-Khaliq, who said:

I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about the time of Zuhr, so he said: After the sun’s decline by a footspan or about that, except on Friday or during travel, for indeed its time then is when the sun declines. And this report does not contradict.

key_terms.بَعْدَ الزَّوَالِ: after the sun passes its zenith
key_terms.بِقَدَمٍ: by the measure of a footspan, indicating a short delay
key_terms.تَزُولُ الشَّمْسُ: the sun declines from the zenith
key_terms.وَقْتِ الظُّهْرِ: the prescribed time of the Zuhr prayer
key_terms.يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ: Friday, for which a special ruling is mentioned

ai.seo_question: When does the time of Zuhr begin on Friday and during travel according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith discusses the time of Zuhr prayer and states that it is ordinarily after the sun’s decline by about a footspan or near that amount. It makes an exception for Friday and for travel, in which case the time begins immediately at the sun’s decline.
